name: eWeLL Co.,Ltd.
summary: eWeLL Co., Ltd., formed in 2012 with headquarters in Osaka, Japan, develops cloud-based business support services for visiting nursing stations in Japan. Its core offering is iBow, a SaaS solution to improve customer productivity, together with iBow Receipt, a receipt system with insurance claim functions, iBow KINTAI, an attendance system for nursing staff, and a nursing care claim transmission service.
